The Librarian's Welcome Message It is my great pleasure to welcome you to Ahmadu Bello University Library Complex (ABULC). The Library is committed to support the overall vision and mission of Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria. Our commitment is demonstrated via the provision of relevant information resources geared towards achieving the mandate of the University in general. Similarly, it is part of the mission of the library to make the local contents of the University visible globally. Read More Kashim Ibrahim Library has been an invaluable resource for my studies, providing access to critical information and a welcoming environment.
